facts.fact: INTIC states that the e-government interoperability work applies the Regulamento do Quadro de Interoperabilidade dos Sistemas do Governo Electronico, Decreto 90/2020 of 9 October.
facts.system: Quadro de Interoperabilidade dos Sistemas do Governo Electronico

note: No requirement on public bodies or enforcing body is stated, and the meeting on 16 November 2023 was to discuss technical specifications, not to show bodies following the framework.
